title: The ?author= filter branch is implemented but no test exercises it
evidence: main.go:125-127 takes the LIKE-filtered query path; main_test.go:104-118 TestGetBooks issues GET /books with no query string, so the filter branch never runs
suggestion: Add a test that creates two books by different authors and asserts GET /books?author=X returns only the matching one

title: Error responses are text/plain, not JSON, unlike the success responses
evidence: main.go:86 http.Error(w, "Title and author are required", 400) — http.Error sets Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8; same at main.go:80, 165, 174, 261
suggestion: Emit a JSON error envelope (e.g. {"error": "..."}) with the same status codes so the API speaks one content type

title: setupTestDB unlinks books.db and reopens the global pool without closing the previous one
evidence: main_test.go:16-22 calls os.Remove then initDB(), which reassigns the package-level db at main.go:31 while the prior *sql.DB is still open; 7 tests each leak one pool
suggestion: Close db if non-nil before reopening, or use a t.Cleanup-registered temp-file database per test

title: The /books/{id} method dispatch in main() has no test coverage
evidence: main.go:288-308 routes GET/PUT/DELETE by method; every test calls the handler function directly (e.g. main_test.go:93 getBookHandler(w, req)), which is why stored test_coverage is 0.507
suggestion: Build the mux in a testable newRouter() and drive tests through httptest.Server or mux.ServeHTTP

title: GET /books encodes JSON null rather than [] when the collection is empty
evidence: main.go:139 var books []Book stays nil when no rows match, and main.go:151 json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(books) writes null
suggestion: Initialise books := []Book{} so an empty collection serialises as []

title: Per-handler method guards are unreachable given the dispatchers
evidence: main.go:73-76, 114-117, 187-190, 242-245 re-check r.Method, but booksHandler (main.go:61-68) and the /books/ closure (main.go:292-304) already switched on it
suggestion: Drop the duplicated guards, or drop the dispatcher switch and keep the guards — not both

title: 7 tests delivered against a minimum of 3, including the 400-validation path
evidence: main_test.go defines 7 Test functions (grep -c '^func Test' = 7), 0 t.Skip calls; TestCreateBookWithMissingRequiredFields at main_test.go:196 covers R9
suggestion: None — recorded as an above-spec observation
